title: Just My Two Cents
speaker: Pastor Mike Roth
description: Pastor Mike Roth explores sacrificial living, spiritual poverty, and societal inequality, urging compassion and the value of every person through the widow's mite story. Recorded on November 10, 2024 at St. Paul's UCC.
body:
Pastor Mike Roth explores sacrificial living, spiritual poverty, and societal inequality, urging compassion and the value of every person through the widow's mite story.

Recorded on November 10, 2024 at St. Paul's UCC.
